history.content: Can I afford a $400 trip to Austin next weekend?

Short answer: based on what you've logged, no, not without blowing this week's budget. You're at $395 of your $400 for this week (dining $275, Amazon $120), so a $400 trip puts you roughly $395 over what's logged against the budget. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. And $400 is under your $500 standing cap, so I wouldn't need to ask twice, but the budget math says to pause first. If you want it to work: I can help hunt cheaper flights/lodging for next weekend, or we treat this as next week's spend. Want me to check real Austin prices?
